title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Data Privacy Process
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a mobile app collects, handles, and stores a user's personal data, from the moment the user first opens the app to the point at which the data is deleted. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约2分钟分析流程图：数清步骤数量，找出起点与终点，注意哪些步骤涉及用户授权、哪些涉及数据存储或删除。写作时使用一般现在时被动语态描述流程，并用顺序连接词（first, next, then, finally）组织段落。不要加入个人观点或解释原因。

figure.title: Mobile App Personal Data Handling Process
steps: User downloads and opens the app
App displays a privacy consent screen
User reviews and accepts the privacy policy
App collects basic profile data (name, email, device ID)
Data is encrypted and sent to the app's secure server
Server stores the data in a user account database
User can request to view or delete their data in settings
Server permanently deletes the data within 30 days of request
